svg.title: A little school, drawn by hand
svg.desc: A white-background hand-drawn school floor layout. The principal sits in a private office at upper left. Below, a librarian sits reading behind the library desk surrounded by bookshelves. The central staffroom has seated staff at a shared table and a tea corner. At right, a seated teacher faces six students, each on a chair at their own desk. An open corridor connects all four rooms. Characters are yellow bean-shaped Xiaohei figures with black dot eyes.
